actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent, biologically interpretable identity: RNA Hallmark ssGSEA shows a concentrated inflammatory/immune-up program (ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION SMD 0.905, IL6_JAK_STAT3 SMD 0.868, both q=0.0001) with 26/50 pathways significant, and CNV shows a mutually compatible pattern (higher VHL/chr20q, more chr14q and CDKN2A loss, 19/49 continuous features significant). WXS is only nominal (min q=0.223) but does not contradict the identity. Measured technical factors provide no dominant alternative explanation: no global or set-specific technical association is significant (all q>0.18, deterministic flags negative). Membership is structurally compatible: all five modalities show positive fixed-membership silhouettes, patient support is moderate (median 3 of 5), and the internal SNF probe is non-degenerate with high fraction silhouette positive (0.913) and moderate resampling stability (ARI 0.604). The C0001-C0002 boundary is weak in fused space, but weak separation alone is not positive evidence for Split or Merge, and no reproducible internal partition or better-supported pairwise merge is demonstrated. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is therefore better supported than Drop.

C0002 has a coherent identity that mirrors and is internally consistent with C0001: RNA shows the reciprocal pattern (ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION SMD -0.905, IL6_JAK_STAT3 SMD -0.868, PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS SMD 0.911, all q<0.001; 26/50 pathways significant) and CNV shows the reciprocal VHL/chr20q/chr14q/CDKN2A pattern (19/49 continuous features significant). WXS is nominal only (min q=0.223) and does not contradict the identity. No measured technical factor provides a dominant alternative explanation (all technical associations non-significant, q>0.18). Membership is structurally compatible: WSI, RNA, and CNV silhouettes are positive (RNA 0.0385, CNV 0.0234), patient support is moderate (median 3 of 5), and the internal SNF probe is non-degenerate with high fraction silhouette positive (0.912) and moderate resampling stability (ARI 0.590). The weak fused boundary to C0001 and near-zero CT/WXS silhouettes are limitations, not positive evidence for Split or Merge, and no reproducible substructure or better-supported merge is demonstrated. Retaining C0002 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.
